objectives.title: Venture Underground
objectives.description: The Haunted Mines will periodically open with an Undead Army underneath!

objectives.title: Collect the Skulls
objectives.description: Destroy the Undead and collect their Skulls to power your Golems!

objectives.title: Unleash the Golems
objectives.description: After a team has collected 55 Skulls, the Golems will arise for both teams! The more Skulls your team collects, the stronger your Golem!
